name: Contract Owner Authority
risk_boundary: This profile describes required human decision roles. It does not create identity, delegation, legal authority, Valinor authority or ARDA execution identity.

decision_boundaries: accept or reject evidence for the configured workflow
capability_constraints: no external release without explicit authorised human decision
no capability lease created by this profile
no executor selected by this profile
forbidden_claims: contract owner role implies legal authority without organisational evidence
